Darren: Evening ops check — embed-readers queue surge started ~18:12 UTC. Quick summary: backlog ~18k, node-3 error spike, fallback routing enabled. Need handoff: mitigations, ownership for DB replica, and next steps.

Oncall Bot: ALERT: embed-readers QPS↑, 5xx rate 12% (last 15m). Pager triggered to @oncall-sre. https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/EVT-3345

Lina: Put fallback policy in at 18:25 — routing ~35% to model-compact. KV cache hit rate dropped to ~42% which explains CPU per-token increase. Started extra consumers in us-west-2a.

Kevin: Seeing DB read replica lag ~9s between 18:10-18:30; lots of retries. Local query: `SELECT count(*) FROM embed_jobs WHERE state='queued'` -> 17984. Will try a short read promotion on replica-2 to catch up.

Alex: I kicked an emergency bump: `kubectl scale deployment embed-readers --replicas=8 -n prod-us-west-2a`. CPU per pod 75% -> ~45% after scale. Dash: https://console.redwood/reports/embeders

SRE Runbooks: Runbook excerpt:
```bash
# graceful queue drain (ops endpoint)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/ops/queue/drain\
  -d '{"service":"embed-readers","target":5000}'\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${OPS_TOKEN}'
```
Use with care — this will place additional load on DB replicas.

Darren: Actions for overnight: @Lina keep fallback at 30% unless error rate <2%; @Kevin continue DB replication catch-up and consider read-only promotion if lag > 15s; @Alex maintain autoscaler min=6 for us-west-2. I'll handle customer comms. Any blockers? :thumbsup:

Lina: No blockers from my side. I'll watch KV cache rebuild and purge stale prefixes if traffic stabilizes.

Kevin: If replica doesn't catch up in 20m I'll promote to primary for reads temporarily and follow runbook step 4. Command I'll run if needed:
```sql
-- promote replica-2 for reads
CALL repl.promote('replica-2');
```

Alex: Deploy queued PR to reduce prefetch batch size (PR #4823) — will land in ~30m, can roll forward if we see regressions.

Darren: Handoff snapshot: backlog ~6.8k, 5xx rate ~3.2% (down). Next update 19:00 UTC or sooner. Tagging @oncall-sre for visibility.
